theme: Last day on the water; the trip home starts tomorrow.
greeting: Your final morning of the Croatia charter, Dan — the calendar is empty and the water is yours. The one thing that really matters today is sorting the disembark logistics while you still have a signal.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat disembark logistics from dry land
needsAttention.detail: Charter connectivity goes once you cast off, so arrange today: the Komolac to Cavtat transfer for Saturday around noon, a bag hold ahead of the 3 PM check-in, and the roughly 5:15 AM Sunday checkout plus airport taxi for LH4297.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the St Pete Airbnb as its charge lands today
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 27 to Oct 5 St Pete booking charges today; check it flipped from pending to confirmed, and this is the last day to swap for a better option before it is paid.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sunday landing car and the Sept 20 to 22 room
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sunday at 3:55 PM with no full-size SUV reserved and nowhere to stay the nights of the 20th and 21st before Tuesday's pickup. Both are overdue and needed before you leave Croatia.

flagged.title: LinkedIn message from Claudia Kruse
flagged.detail: She messaged you three days ago and it is still unread, worth a look while you are actively networking.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and shop promos: VRBO, Monocle, Substack, Teddy Stratford, plus Dex keep-in-touch nudges.

recipe.title: Pumpkin chiffon pie
recipe.why: Autumn brings the first winter squash and pumpkins to the market, sweet and ready for the oven.

tasks.title: Book Maine Christmas SUV out of Portland
Buy Disney tickets for the Sept 26 to 27 weekend

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar today, the last open morning of the Croatia trip.
The charter winds down and the water stays yours a little longer.
An early night ahead of tomorrow's move to Cavtat and Sunday's flight home.
